csv_project_name: A/E Service for Engineering Technology Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: This renovation would be in support of the College s Engineering Technology programs in our Engineering Technologies building. The two main ones would be a new Mechanical Engineering Technology (MET) program and a revised Electrical Engineering Technology (EET) program. This would include creating the lecture and lab space for the MET program. The lecture space is shared among all programs but the lab space would be specifically for MET, including lab space for material science, strength of materials, metrology, and quality control. There would be updates to the existing EET labs which are very outdated, to ensure curriculum and labs are representing a current modern manufacturing environment. Additionally, there would be an integration lab where various disciplines collaborate in a capstone type course working in a simulated manufacturing setting. There is also a FAB lab or "Maker Space" that will be used to build prototypes and prove out concepts as well as providing a space to help entice or motivate youth into STEM careers. The renovation will also include new windows and updating the building restrooms and various finishes
